dycr.rz: current measured channel/Nb-dependent RZ; exact on Nb axes, DY-yield-weighted effective factor on inclusive physical axes

uncertainty.physical_cr: MC stat plus available Up/Down envelopes and luminosity; GCR unit-area shape envelopes, luminosity omitted
uncertainty.sr: MC statistical only at the initial model parameters; excludes RZ constraint and GCR-fit covariance

gcr_normalization: data and total MC independently unit-area normalized for shape comparison
sr_normalization: CR-corrected prefit: nominal RZ times initial Sgamma, each applied once; no fitted parameters or renderer rescaling

validation.current_png_visual_review: representative physical/GNN CR plots in both years and both combined SR plots

caveats: 2025 upstream campaign excludes 11 files including one data file; complete data luminosity coverage is not certified.
GNN CR plots show four five-bin parent categories side by side, not category-summed distributions.
SR curves are CR-corrected prefit predictions, not raw MC or postfit results. The SR band contains MC statistics only.
